GIGABYTE GeForce RTX 5060 Ti WINDFORCE MAX OC 16GB Graphics Card (16GB GDDR7 Memory / Factory Overclocked / WINDFORCE Cooling System with Dual Alternate Spinning Fans / Pure Copper Heat Pipes / Protection Backplate / DisplayPort 1.4a & HDMI 2.1a / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Experience high-frame-rate 1440p gaming and advanced content creation with the GIGABYTE GeForce RTX 5060 Ti WINDFORCE MAX OC 16GB graphics card, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Powered by the latest NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and packed with 16GB of high-speed GDDR7 VRAM, this card delivers exceptional Ray Tracing performance and AI-accelerated rendering with DLSS support. Featuring the signature WINDFORCE cooling system with alternate spinning unique blade fans, composite copper heat pipes direct touch GPU, 3D Active Fan technology, and a durable protection backplate, it guarantees maximum thermal efficiency and stability during intense gaming sessions.
